name: 36261-prefillheavy-qwen3moe30b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 on ONE node, sm90, NVLink between the four cards. Driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: One engine over the four GPUs: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism at width 4 (32 of the 128 experts per rank) with expert-parallel load balancing on. Four GPUs are not reducible: the balancer refuses to start at parallel width 1.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM: 48 layers, all of them MoE, 128 routed experts at top-8, 32 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, FP8 e4m3 block-quantised; ~31 GB of weights, ~7.7 GB per card at TP=4.
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop) at 15 req/s, bounded at 2000 requests with a 1200 s safety cap, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, static seed 36261.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompt EXACTLY 1024 tokens and output EXACTLY 128 (min = max), temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos, prefix caching off.
purpose: A mixture-of-experts document analysis assistant handling steady 1024-token prompts with short replies across four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true
enable-eplb: true
# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE as a single flow mapping: the reader is line-based and skips indented
# lines, so re-flowing this into a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts without it.
eplb-config: {"window_size": 10, "step_interval": 100000000, "num_redundant_experts": 0, "log_balancedness": false, "log_balancedness_interval": 128}
all2all-backend: allgather_reducescatter
async-scheduling: true
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.8
